description: Bounded deterministic min-max hooking and pointer compression for undirected connected components.

source.source_header_copyright: Copyright (c) 2015, The Regents of the University of California (Regents)

input.edge_rule: Simple undirected graph with canonical 0 <= u < v < node_count pairs; duplicate edges are invalid.
input.adjacency_order: Ascending neighbor vertex ID; source rows are visited in ascending vertex ID.

output.encoding: One minimum-vertex component representative per vertex, in vertex-ID order.

workspace.meaning: Staged maximum-sized label output so invalid input and output errors leave caller memory untouched.

contract.operation: Initialize one parent label per vertex; repeatedly scan undirected adjacency entries, hook the higher current component ID to the lower when the higher is a root, and compress parent paths until a sweep makes no changes.
contract.hooking: For each edge, read the current labels of its endpoints, compute high=max(label_u,label_v) and low=min(label_u,label_v), and assign parent[high]=low only when parent[high]==high.
contract.compression: After each complete row-major edge sweep, replace each label by its grandparent until its parent points to itself.
contract.deterministic_profile: The pinned source uses parallel in-place hooking. This bounded profile fixes vertex and neighbor scan order to ascending IDs and uses a single worker; it preserves the min-max hooking and compression mechanics while avoiding scheduler-dependent races.
contract.round_limit: At most node_count squared plus one sweeps; the guard exceeds the number of possible strict root-label decreases in the bounded graph.
